method.name: EXACTONE_AFFINE_NULLITY_CERTIFICATE_SOLVER
method.operator: Build necessary GF(2) equations from signed 1- and 3-literal exact-one clauses, eliminate over GF(2) with XOR source lineages, and enumerate all affine free-coordinate candidates only when their dimension k is bounded; test each against original exact-one constraints
method.polynomial_if: k=O(log L) with polynomial factor and a resource budget allowing enumeration
method.consistency: UNSAT_XOR uses source-clause XOR lineage proving 0=1
method.sat: Original full assignment and valid free-coordinate witness
method.unsat: One violated original exact-one clause per enumerated affine candidate
method.fail_closed: OPEN_NULLITY_CAP when k > configured maximum free dimension; max allowed 10, default 4
method.proof_authority: Independent verifier reconstructs all original parity rows, checks rank-complete RREF and source lineage, checks all candidate rejections and any original-clause satisfying witness
method.limitation: No universal polynomial bound if k grows linearly with n

high_treewidth_unsatisfiable.certificate: Single remaining affine candidate violates original exact-one hub/pair clauses; XOR system by itself consistent

academic_position.mathematical_principle: Classical affine linear-algebra relaxation plus bounded-k exhaustive reconstruction; special tractable class, not a general result P=NP
academic_position.structural_advance: An infinite high-treewidth clique family becomes tractable through low GF(2) nullity; demonstrates primal width is sufficient but not necessary for tractability
academic_position.relation_to_prior: Orthogonal to bounded-treewidth DP and bounded variable feedback cutset
academic_position.open_barrier: Need a polynomial uniformly compact exact representation and polynomial-time construction/composition/decision/witness reconstruction for arbitrary high-treewidth, high-affine-nullity cyclic Exact-One instances
